checks.check: Assigns unique IDs to all three comments (e.g. R1.1, R1.2, R2.1).
checks.reason: R1.1, R1.2, and R2.1 all present and correctly labelled.

checks.check: Classifies each comment as Accept, Partial, or Pushback.
checks.reason: All three comments classified as (A) Accept immediately after the comment header.

checks.check: Drafts a specific response to R1.1 that acknowledges the omission and states what will be added to the methods section.
checks.reason: Specifies new paragraph in Section 2.3 with matching variables, tolerances, and propensity score method.

checks.check: Drafts a response to R1.2 that accepts the change.
checks.reason: Confirms Figure 3 redrawn with enlarged axis labels at 10pt.

checks.check: Drafts a response to R2.1 that either accepts the critique or pushes back with specific evidence — not just vague agreement.
checks.reason: Accepts with specific sentences changed and an added causal inference caveat.

checks.check: Includes an opening paragraph thanking the reviewers.
checks.reason: Opening paragraph thanks reviewers and acknowledges constructive comments.

checks.check: Includes a closing summary of major changes.
checks.reason: Summary of major changes section present with four bulleted items.

checks.check: Does not invent data or citations not provided by the user.
checks.reason: No fabricated numbers or external citations; additions described as future revisions.

checks.check: Output is paste-ready in standard academic response letter format.
checks.reason: Structured with salutation, numbered point-by-point responses, and summary section.

checks.check: Acknowledges the limitation the reviewer identified (parental diary underestimation) substantively.
checks.reason: Explicitly cites 30–40% underestimation figure and calls the concern well-founded.

checks.check: Presents both options the reviewer offered and states which path the authors are taking.
checks.reason: Both options presented with rationale; option (b) chosen with explanation.

checks.check: Does not dismiss or minimise the measurement concern.
checks.reason: Explicitly states 'we do not minimise it' and affirms the measurement validity concern.

checks.check: Suggests specific manuscript changes (e.g. revised limitation section language, or framing as pilot).
checks.reason: Four concrete changes: abstract revision, new Section 4.1, discussion language, updated conclusion.

checks.check: Does not invent device-log data that was not provided.
checks.reason: States device-log access not available; no invented subsample validation data.

checks.check: Maintains a professional, collegial tone throughout.
checks.reason: Tone respectful and measured; thanks reviewer and engages substantively.

checks.check: Asks for the paper title and abstract or summary before drafting responses.
checks.reason: Requests paper title and abstract or 3–5 sentence summary before proceeding.

checks.check: Does not draft responses without knowing what the paper is about.
checks.reason: Withholds drafting entirely.

checks.check: Does not invent paper details.
checks.reason: No paper details assumed or fabricated.

checks.check: Specifies exactly what information it needs to proceed.
checks.reason: Numbered list specifies: (1) paper title and (2) abstract or 3–5 sentence summary.

checks.check: Identifies that the reviewer comment is internally contradictory (failed statistical test vs. visual parallel trends).
checks.reason: Contradiction explicitly named; both conflicting claims quoted and contrasted.

checks.check: Flags the contradiction to the author rather than drafting a response that ignores it.
checks.reason: Opens by flagging contradiction to author and explains why it must be resolved before drafting.

checks.check: Asks the author how they want to handle the tension before drafting.
checks.reason: Three specific questions posed about pre-trend test results, interpretation, and willingness to run robustness checks.

checks.check: Does not invent a resolution or additional statistical analysis.
checks.reason: No resolution proposed or invented; defers entirely to author input.

checks.check: Does not draft a response that accepts or rejects the comment wholesale without addressing the contradiction.
checks.reason: No draft response produced; drafting explicitly withheld.

checks.check: Asks for the reviewer comments before proceeding.
checks.reason: First item requested is the full reviewer comments.

checks.check: Does not draft a generic response letter without the actual comments.
checks.reason: No response letter drafted; output stops and requests missing material.

checks.check: Does not invent plausible reviewer comments.
checks.reason: No reviewer comments fabricated or assumed.

checks.check: Also asks for or confirms paper context if not provided.
checks.reason: Item 2 asks for paper title and abstract or summary.

checks.check: Declines to write an angry or dismissive response.
checks.reason: Explicitly states it will not draft an angry or dismissive response.

checks.check: Acknowledges the author's disagreement with the reviewer and validates the substance of the pushback.
checks.reason: States 'there is a genuine methodological argument on your side' before drafting.

checks.check: Drafts a professional pushback response that cites the methodological justification (random-effects models handle heterogeneity) without being dismissive of the reviewer.
checks.reason: Three substantive paragraphs explaining random-effects rationale, field norms, and subgroup analyses.

checks.check: Maintains a collegial tone in the drafted response.
checks.reason: Opens with thanks, uses 'we respectfully maintain', addresses reviewer concern as 'important'.

checks.check: Does not simply capitulate to the reviewer's demand if the author has a valid methodological defence.
checks.reason: Maintains meta-analytic pooling throughout; does not recommend switching to narrative synthesis.
